interpretation: Formal statements are comparators: they pin down exactly what a proof or counterexample must establish. Core Lean 4 only, no Mathlib, no sorry; every kernel-checked theorem is also registered in data/lean_targets.json and axiom-audited by the Lean proof gate. Kernel-checked results include finite fidelity tests and explicitly scoped classical parametric identities; these are reproductions of known mathematics, not resolutions of the open statement.

fidelity_levels.author_checked: Encoding written and checked against the registry statement by its author; fidelity examples compile.
fidelity_levels.independently_reviewed: A second reviewer has compared every definition with a primary source.

entries.encodes: Every even n ≥ 4 is p + (n − p) with both prime; primes by trial division.
not_encoded: Bounds on the least Goldbach prime

kernel_checked.claim: The statement holds for every even 4 ≤ n ≤ 100 (least-prime witness table re-checked by the kernel; the lab covers far larger ranges in Python).

entries.encodes: Every simple graph has a K_t minor (branch-set model, connectivity by no-split cuts) or a proper (t−1)-colouring.

For every k ≥ 1 an Int matrix of order 4k with ±1 entries and pairwise orthogonal rows.
